series.label: Registered births, Lebanon
series.notes: CAS vital statistics from Ministry of Interior civil registry, 1999-2025. Registration counts by year of registration, not necessarily event year. Yearly sheet ends 2024; 2025 appears only as Jan-Jul in the monthly sheet (births 44,068) and is excluded. Bekaa registrations dip in 2001-2005 (administrative gap), so national totals for those years are likely undercounts. 2025 may be provisional.

series.label: Outward remittances from Lebanon (World Bank bilateral matrix)
series.notes: World Bank bilateral remittance estimates, May 2021 vintage. Outflows by Lebanon as origin, sum over destination countries. Modelled estimates, not measured. Row orientation (Lebanon as sending country) read from the sheet title; medium confidence. 2000-2001 zeros in source dropped as missing.
